title: Package
description: Descriptor for a published WasmAgent protocol package release — the machine-readable manifest of which canonical schemas a given version of @wasmagent/protocol (npm) / wasmagent-protocol (PyPI) bundles, where it is published, and the canonical host its schemas resolve under. Lets consumers pin and verify a release against the registry without depending on prose.

name.description: Published package name, e.g. @wasmagent/protocol (npm) or wasmagent-protocol (PyPI)

version.description: Semver release version of the package, e.g. 0.1.7

canonical_host.description: Canonical host prefix every bundled schema $id resolves under, e.g. https://wasmagent.dev/schemas/

registries.description: Distribution registries the package is published to

name.description: Registry identifier, e.g. npm or pypi

url.description: Canonical registry URL for this package release

schemas.description: Canonical schemas bundled in this package release

id.description: Registry id of the bundled schema, e.g. aep-record

version.description: Schema-version tag bundled in this release, e.g. aep/v0.3

stability.description: Contract stability of the bundled schema
